basic_info.description: Timeless elegance with this thoughtfully renovated 1892 Victorian home in the heart of Noe Valley! Featuring three spacious bedrooms and one-and-a-half bathrooms, this house combines classic charm with modern sophistication. Revel in the beautifully finished living room, complete with a fireplace and a picturesque bay window reading nook. The kitchen is a chef's delight, lined with white marble. Tall ceilings and abundant windows usher in incredible natural light throughout the home, and step outside to an inviting outdoor entertaining deck with stunning bay views. The oversized backyard garden, with its desirable southern exposure, offers a private oasis. A large garage and expansive storage room provide ample space for all needs. 4455 23rd is a perfect blend of historical charm and contemporary convenience.
